name: A Level Chemistry: Molewick
subtitle: Labs, mechanisms & mocks
shortDescription: A personal tutor for A level chemistry: adaptive quizzes, titration, spectroscopy and mechanism labs, practical cards and mocks.
longDescription:
A Level Chemistry: Molewick adapts to you. Every answer updates a private model on your device, so the app shows what to revisit, which lab to run and what comes next, in plain words and with the reason why.

### Study Your Way
- Classical order follows the specification for A level chemistry (DfE subject content and AQA 7405 structure), covering 40 topics from atomic structure to organic synthesis, spectroscopy, green chemistry and medicines.
- The Real-World view has you build things step by step: a buffer for a medicine, an ammonia plant, a forensic identification, a hydrogen fuel cell, aspirin and its purity check, a water-treatment checkpoint, an ozone-safe refrigerant and an azo dye. Each step teaches the idea it needs, then checks it.
- Switch between Syllabus and Real-World with one tap. Your progress is shared. Tablets get two-pane layouts so the lesson and your practice sit side by side.

### Learn, Try, Check
- Short lessons with a worked example and the common slips, then quick checks with the reasoning explained.
- Seven labs: titration and pH curves with indicator choice, a spectra detective (MS, IR and NMR), collisions and activation energy, a curly-arrow mechanism trainer, equilibrium and Kc, an electrochemical cell builder, and a find-the-rate-equation kinetics lab.
- 16 practical cards covering the AQA required practicals, OCR practical activity groups, Pearson core practicals and Eduqas specified practical work.
- Unit tests, a cumulative test and 14 board-style mock papers for AQA, OCR A, OCR B (Salters), Pearson Edexcel and Eduqas (shorter, multiple-choice adaptations), each with a report that links every miss back to the lesson.
- 1,170 original questions with worked explanations. Calculated answers were checked by two methods, and a sample was re-solved by an independent reader.
- A Coverage screen lists 140 specification points drawn from 1,751 requirement items in the DfE subject content, AQA 7405, OCR H432 and H433, Pearson 9CH0 and Eduqas, each with at least 8 practice questions, and shows your mastery on each. It shows practice coverage, not a grade promise.
- Optional Other boards chip on every topic and a Curriculum map: see where a topic sits in GCSE, IB and AP.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
